title: Biological Multiplex Flow Formalization — River, Door, Axis and Return
status: scientific analogy / systems-biology formalization; not a new physical theory
purpose: Connect the mature BODY/neurobiology architecture to Potato Dynamics without claiming that Potatoverse theology is established biology or physics. Formalize River as multiple typed biological channels, Door as channel-specific transition/gating, Axis as directed flow/organization, Eye as observation, and Return as feedback.
epistemic_rule: This file borrows standard dynamical-systems, network and control notation to make project analogies precise. It does not establish a new force, new biological law, universal spiritual fluid or single equation of life.

formal_object.notation: B = (X, L, E, F, G, O, T, C)
formal_object.relation_to_potato_dynamics: B is a domain-specific biological instantiation/comparator for P=(S,g,A,D,O,I), not a replacement or empirical validation of the Potato Dynamics master object.

state_vector.schematic: X(t) = [x_neural, x_autonomic, x_cardio, x_resp, x_endocrine, x_immune, x_metabolic, x_fluid, x_organ, x_behavior, x_environment]
state_vector.rule: Each component is itself high-dimensional. Never add unlike variables until units/scales are defined or variables are explicitly nondimensionalized.

layers.topology: directed neural networks with recurrent loops
layers.potatoverse: fast roads/branches; not the whole River

layers.medium: sympathetic/parasympathetic neural signaling plus local ganglia
layers.typical_timescale: seconds to minutes, with longer consequences
layers.topology: central ↔ ganglia ↔ organs with afferent feedback

layers.medium: blood flow and pressure carrying gases, nutrients, hormones, immune cells and metabolites
layers.typical_timescale: seconds to hours depending on variable
layers.topology: closed-loop vascular network driven by heart and local vascular regulation
environment ↔ airway/lungs ↔ blood with neural control

layers.medium: circulating hormones and local paracrine signals
layers.typical_timescale: minutes to days depending on hormone and target
layers.topology: source tissues → circulation → receptor-expressing targets with feedback

layers.medium: immune cells, cytokines, chemokines, antibodies and tissue signaling
layers.topology: blood + lymph + tissue niches + barrier interfaces + neural/endocrine cross-talk
layers.potatoverse: guardians/gardeners; not purity or moral warfare

layers.medium: nutrients, metabolites, substrate flux and cellular energy transformations
layers.topology: gut ↔ liver ↔ pancreas ↔ adipose ↔ muscle ↔ circulation ↔ brain

layers.typical_timescale: seconds-to-hours depending on process and measurement
layers.topology: ventricles ↔ subarachnoid spaces ↔ perivascular/interstitial interfaces with production and drainage routes
layers.potatoverse: inner River/chamber tributary, not Spirit itself

layers.topology: tissue interstitium/meningeal routes → lymphatic vessels/nodes → systemic return

layers.medium: movement, ingestion, speech, social action and environmental modification
layers.potatoverse: manifest action that changes the next state of the Garden

multilayer_graph.meaning: V are biological entities/states; E_l are relations inside a channel layer l; E_lm are cross-layer couplings between layers l and m.
multilayer_graph.project_value: One Potatoverse relation may occupy several biological layers; this is why River should not be represented by one edge type.

door_formalization.principle: A biological Door is any explicitly defined state-dependent transfer, threshold or selective interface. Different Doors use different mathematics.

examples.gate: release probability + receptor state + postsynaptic excitability
molecule/cell-specific permeability, transporters and cellular state
signal requires ligand, receptor and downstream cellular context
network-state transition produced by interacting circadian/homeostatic/arousal systems

examples.status: project canon, not a literal anatomical portal

door_formalization.meaning: For channel i, realized transfer/flux J_i depends on a gate/selectivity function G_i and a channel-specific driving/dynamics term D_i. This is schematic until variables and units are specified.

axis_formalization.principle: In biology Axis is best treated as directed organization or flow through a defined state/structure, not an extra physical dimension.
axis_formalization.meaning: The organism state X changes under internal dynamics F, regulatory/control inputs u and environmental/body perturbations e.
axis_formalization.project_relation: The Potatoverse Axis can compare to preferred directions/flows only after the biological coordinate and measurable variable are named.

eye_observation_formalization.meaning: A sensing subsystem obtains partial/noisy observations y of organism state X through observation map O with noise/uncertainty η.
eye_observation_formalization.project_relation: Eye maps most cleanly to observation/discernment as a function, not one universal anatomical eye.

return_feedback_formalization.loop: X_t → O(X_t) → controller/regulator → action u_t → X_(t+Δt) → new observation
return_feedback_formalization.meaning: Regulatory output depends on an estimate of current state ŷ, reference/need r and potentially prior state/history.
return_feedback_formalization.project_relation: Return-to-center is scientifically strongest as recursive feedback/state estimation rather than movement to one anatomical point.

testability_rules: Every proposed biological coupling must name source, target, medium and direction.
Where possible, give a measurable variable and unit for source/target state.
State the expected timescale and delay.
Distinguish neural, endocrine, immune, vascular, metabolic and fluid channels even when they affect the same organs.
Specify whether evidence is human observational, human intervention, animal causal, cellular/in-vitro or theoretical.
A Potatoverse analogy is not a causal mechanism and receives no scientific confidence merely from structural resemblance.
A unified equation is not useful if its terms combine incompatible units without explicit normalization or model derivation.
candidate_observables: heart rate and heart-rate variability with context-specific interpretation
CSF chemistry/flow measurements with compartment and method specified
behavioral outputs such as feeding, drinking, sleep and movement

project_synthesis.River: set of typed flows F_l, not a universal substance
project_synthesis.Door: channel-specific gate G_i or system transition, with Pineal Door retained as project symbolism
project_synthesis.Axis: directed structural/state flow after a coordinate is specified
project_synthesis.Eye: partial observation map O rather than one universal organ
project_synthesis.House: organized state-space/subsystems; thalamus remains canonical project House without owning all regulation
project_synthesis.Steward: feedback controller family rather than a single homunculus
project_synthesis.Garden: the coupled living system and its environment
project_synthesis.Return: closed-loop updating after action changes state

hard_boundaries: This is not evidence for a fifth biological force.
No equation here demonstrates God, Spirit, soul or divine identity.
River channels are not interchangeable; blood, nerves, hormones, CSF and lymph have different dynamics and units.
Door is not one universal threshold variable across all biology.
Control-system language does not imply a conscious controller inside the brain.
Homeostasis is not perfect constancy; regulation can be anticipatory, adaptive, context-dependent and sometimes maladaptive.
Mathematical elegance does not substitute for empirical parameterization and falsification.
